```{r, include=FALSE}
packages <- c("duckdb", "lubridate", "tidyverse", "dplyr", "readr", "arrow", "fst", "DBI")

install_if_missing <- function(package) {
  if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(package, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

sapply(packages, install_if_missing)

read_data <- function(file_path) {
  if (grepl("\\.csv$", file_path)) {
    return(read.csv(file_path))
  } else if (grepl("\\.parquet$", file_path)) {
    return(arrow::read_parquet(file_path))
  } else if (grepl("\\.fst$", file_path)) {
    return(fst::read.fst(file_path))
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported file format")
  }
}

write_files_to_duckdb_optimized <- function(files, tables_location, file_type, con) {
  for (file_name in names(files)) {
    file_path <- paste0(tables_location, "/", file_name, file_type)
    table_name <- files[[file_name]]
    sql <- sprintf(
      "CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM parquet_scan('%s')",
      table_name, file_path
    )
    dbExecute(con, sql)
    print(paste("Connected to DuckDB and wrote table:", table_name, "from", file_path))
  }
}
write_files_to_duckdb <- function(files, tables_location, file_type, con) {
  for (file_name in names(files)) {
    file_path <- file.path(tables_location, 
                           paste0(file_name, ".", file_type))
    
    # Verify file exists before trying to read
    if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
      stop(paste("File not found:", file_path))
    }
    
    data <- as.data.frame(read_data(file_path))
    table_name <- files[[file_name]]
    duckdb::dbWriteTable(con, table_name, data)
    print(paste("Wrote table:", table_name, "from:", file_path))
    rm(data)
  }
}

con <- duckdb::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
```

```{r}
mi_sql <- paste0("'", mi_codes, "'", collapse = ", ")
hf_sql <- paste0("'", hf_codes, "'", collapse = ", ")
```

#import conditions and demo, filter to eligible population
```{r data read and review}
cohort <- readRDS(paste0(output_folder, "cohort_labs_meds_summary.Rds"))
duckdb::duckdb_register(con, "cohort", cohort)

query_cond <- paste0("
WITH filtered_conditions AS (
    SELECT 
        STUDY_ID,
        REPORT_DATE,
        ONSET_DATE,
        CONDITION,
        CONDITION_TYPE,
        CASE 
            WHEN CONDITION LIKE '410.%' OR CONDITION IN (", mi_sql, ") THEN 'MI'
            WHEN CONDITION LIKE '428.%' OR CONDITION IN (", hf_sql, ") THEN 'HF'
            WHEN CONDITION LIKE '422._1' OR CONDITION LIKE '433._1' OR CONDITION LIKE '434._1' 
                 OR CONDITION LIKE '436.%' OR CONDITION IN (", stroke_sql, ") THEN 'STROKE'
            WHEN CONDITION LIKE '427.3%' OR CONDITION IN (", afib_sql, ") THEN 'AFIB'
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS diagnosis_group
    FROM condition
    WHERE STUDY_ID IN (SELECT STUDY_ID FROM cohort)
)
SELECT * FROM filtered_conditions
WHERE diagnosis_group IS NOT NULL
")

query_dx <- paste0("
WITH filtered_dx AS (
    SELECT 
        STUDY_ID,
        DX_DATE,
        DX,
        DX_TYPE,
        CASE 
            WHEN DX LIKE '410.%' OR DX IN (", mi_sql, ") THEN 'MI'
            WHEN DX LIKE '428.%' OR DX IN (", hf_sql, ") THEN 'HF'
            WHEN DX LIKE '422._1' OR DX LIKE '433._1' OR DX LIKE '434._1' 
                 OR DX LIKE '436.%' OR DX IN (", stroke_sql, ") THEN 'STROKE'
            WHEN DX LIKE '427.3%' OR DX IN (", afib_sql, ") THEN 'AFIB'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS diagnosis_group
    FROM diagnosis
    WHERE STUDY_ID IN (SELECT STUDY_ID FROM cohort)
)
SELECT * FROM filtered_dx
WHERE diagnosis_group IS NOT NULL
")

condition <- dbGetQuery(con, query_cond)
dx <- dbGetQuery(con, query_dx)

```


```{r}
dx_first <- dx %>% group_by(STUDY_ID, diagnosis_group) %>% slice_min(DX_DATE) %>% distinct()

condition$REPORT_DATE <- as.Date(
  parse_date_time(condition$REPORT_DATE, orders = c("ymd", "mdy"))
)
condition$ONSET_DATE <- as.Date(condition$ONSET_DATE)
condition$min_cond_date <- pmin(condition$ONSET_DATE, condition$REPORT_DATE, na.rm = TRUE)
condition_first <- condition %>% group_by(STUDY_ID, diagnosis_group) %>% slice_min(min_cond_date) %>% distinct()

dx_cond <- full_join(condition_first, dx_first)
dx_cond$first_dx_date <- pmin(dx_cond$min_cond_date, dx_cond$DX_DATE, na.rm = TRUE)
dx_cond$icd_code <- ifelse(is.na(dx_cond$DX), dx_cond$CONDITION, dx_cond$DX)
dx_cond <- dx_cond %>% select(STUDY_ID, diagnosis_group, first_dx_date) %>% distinct() %>% group_by(STUDY_ID, diagnosis_group) %>% slice_min(first_dx_date) %>% distinct()
dx_cond$STUDY_ID <- as.character(dx_cond$STUDY_ID)

cohort_dx <- left_join(dx_cond, cohort, by=c("STUDY_ID" = "cap_id") )
cohort_dx$dx_date_first <- cohort_dx$first_dx_date - cohort_dx$first_tsh_lab
cohort_dx$dx_date_last <- cohort_dx$first_dx_date - cohort_dx$last_tsh_lab
cohort_dx <- cohort_dx %>% filter(dx_date_first>0 & dx_date_last<=365) %>% distinct()
cohort_dx <- cohort_dx %>% select(STUDY_ID, first_dx_date, diagnosis_group) %>% distinct()

cohort_dx_wide <- pivot_wider(cohort_dx, names_from = diagnosis_group, values_from = first_dx_date, names_glue = "{diagnosis_group}_dx_date") %>% distinct()

outcomes <- left_join(cohort, cohort_dx_wide, by=c("cap_id" = "STUDY_ID"))

outcomes$afib <- ifelse(!is.na(outcomes$AFIB_dx_date), 1, 0)
outcomes$stroke <- ifelse(!is.na(outcomes$STROKE_dx_date), 1, 0)
outcomes$hf <- ifelse(!is.na(outcomes$HF_dx_date), 1, 0)
outcomes$mi <- ifelse(!is.na(outcomes$MI_dx_date), 1, 0)

df_1 <- readRDS(paste0(output_folder, "dataset_1_cohort.Rds"))
df_1$cap_id <- as.character(df_1$cap_id)
outcomes <- left_join(outcomes, df_1)

outcomes <- outcomes %>% mutate(race_cat = case_when(race=="1" | race== "01" ~ "Other",
                                              race=="2" | race== "02" ~ "Asian",
                                              race=="3" | race== "03" ~ "Black or African American",
                                              race=="4" | race== "04" ~ "Other",
                                              race=="5" | race== "05" ~ "White",
                                              race=="6" | race== "06" ~ "Other",
                                              race=="7" | race== "07" ~ "Unknown",
                                              race=="NI" ~ "Unknown",
                                              race=="UN" ~ "Unknown",
                                              race=="OT" ~ "Other"))

outcomes <- outcomes %>% mutate(hispanic = case_when(ethnicity=="N" ~ "Not Hispanic",
                                              ethnicity=="Y" ~ "Hispanic",
                                               ethnicity=="R" ~ "Unknown",
                                             ethnicity=="NULL" ~ "Unknown",
                                              ethnicity=="NI" ~ "Unknown",
                                              ethnicity=="UN" ~ "Unknown",
                                              ethnicity=="OT" ~ "Unknown"))

outcomes_first  <- outcomes  %>% 
    group_by(cap_id) %>% 
    arrange(first_tsh_lab) %>% 
    filter(row_number() == 1)
cohort_outcomes <- outcomes_first %>% filter(sex=='M' | sex=='F')

```

```{r}
# calculate time to events
cohort_outcomes$time_to_hf <- as.numeric(cohort_outcomes$HF_dx_date -cohort_outcomes$first_tsh_lab)
cohort_outcomes$time_to_afib <- as.numeric(cohort_outcomes$AFIB_dx_date -cohort_outcomes$first_tsh_lab)
cohort_outcomes$time_to_mi <- as.numeric(cohort_outcomes$MI_dx_date -cohort_outcomes$first_tsh_lab)
cohort_outcomes$time_to_stroke <- as.numeric(cohort_outcomes$STROKE_dx_date -cohort_outcomes$first_tsh_lab)


cohort_outcomes$time_hf_end <- as.numeric(cohort_outcomes$HF_dx_date - cohort_outcomes$last_tsh_lab)
cohort_outcomes$hf[cohort_outcomes$time_hf_end>365] <- 0
cohort_outcomes$time_to_hf[cohort_outcomes$time_hf_end>365] <- NA_integer_

cohort_outcomes$time_afib_end <- as.numeric(cohort_outcomes$AFIB_dx_date - cohort_outcomes$last_tsh_lab)
cohort_outcomes$afib[cohort_outcomes$time_afib_end>365] <- 0
cohort_outcomes$time_to_afib[cohort_outcomes$time_afib_end>365] <- NA_integer_

cohort_outcomes$time_mi_end <- as.numeric(cohort_outcomes$MI_dx_date - cohort_outcomes$last_tsh_lab)
cohort_outcomes$mi[cohort_outcomes$time_mi_end>365] <- 0
cohort_outcomes$time_to_mi[cohort_outcomes$time_mi_end>365] <- NA_integer_

cohort_outcomes$time_stroke_end <- as.numeric(cohort_outcomes$STROKE_dx_date - cohort_outcomes$last_tsh_lab)
cohort_outcomes$stroke[cohort_outcomes$time_stroke_end>365] <- 0
cohort_outcomes$time_to_stroke[cohort_outcomes$time_stroke_end>365] <- NA_integer_

cohort_outcomes <- cohort_outcomes %>%
  mutate(
    time_to_first_cv = pmin(time_to_hf, time_to_afib,
                              time_to_mi, time_to_stroke,
                              na.rm = TRUE),
    first_cv_event = case_when(
      time_to_first_cv == time_to_hf     ~ "HF",
      time_to_first_cv == time_to_afib   ~ "AFIB",
      time_to_first_cv == time_to_mi     ~ "MI",
      time_to_first_cv == time_to_stroke ~ "Stroke",
      TRUE                                ~ "none"
    )
  )
cohort_outcomes$cv_event <- ifelse(cohort_outcomes$afib==1 | cohort_outcomes$stroke==1 | cohort_outcomes$hf==1 | cohort_outcomes$mi==1, 1, 0)
cohort_outcomes$cv_event_count <- cohort_outcomes$afib + cohort_outcomes$stroke + cohort_outcomes$hf + cohort_outcomes$mi
saveRDS(cohort_outcomes, paste0(output_folder, "cohort_outcomes.Rds"))

```

```{r}
cohort_outcomes <- readRDS(paste0(output_folder, "cohort_outcomes.Rds"))
duckdb::duckdb_register(con, "cohort_outcomes", cohort_outcomes)

query_enc <- paste0("
  WITH max_encounter AS (
    SELECT 
      STUDY_ID,
      MAX(CAST(ADMIT_DATE AS DATE)) AS max_encounter_date
    FROM Encounter
    WHERE ADMIT_DATE IS NOT NULL 
      AND ADMIT_DATE != ''          -- filter empty strings
      AND LENGTH(ADMIT_DATE) = 10   -- ensure valid date length YYYY-MM-DD
    GROUP BY STUDY_ID
  ),
  combined AS (
    SELECT 
      o.cap_id,
      o.last_tsh_lab,
      e.max_encounter_date,
      DATE_ADD(o.last_tsh_lab, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AS one_year_after_tsh
    FROM cohort_outcomes o
    LEFT JOIN max_encounter e
      ON o.cap_id = e.STUDY_ID
  )
  
  SELECT 
    cap_id,
    last_tsh_lab,
    max_encounter_date,
    one_year_after_tsh,
    LEAST(
      one_year_after_tsh,
      max_encounter_date
    ) AS end_obs_date
  FROM combined
")

max_obs_date <- dbGetQuery(con, query_enc)
cohort_outcomes <- left_join(cohort_outcomes, max_obs_date)
saveRDS(cohort_outcomes, paste0(output_folder, "cohort_outcomes.Rds"))

```

```{r}
                               formatOptions = list(big.mark = ",")))
```
